items.t: Arm Just Dropped 21% in a Month. Will ARM Stock Hit $150 or $200 First?
items.sum: Arm has shed a fifth of its value in a month, leaving bulls and bears staring at two very different price levels. A stretched valuation, defensive options bets, and a surprisingly strong pipeline all collide in the fight over where shares head next.

items.t: Who Is Rene Haas? What to Know About the Arm CEO as Nvidia Searches for Jensen Huang's Successor
items.sum: Hendrick & Struggles, the firm Nvidia hired to help it find a successor for Jensen Huang, has reportedly approached Arm’s Rene Haas. Haas already has experience with Nvidia.
